_meta.description: Click the 'Copy API key' button for a key row in Google AI Studio. The full key value is written to the OS clipboard — readable via pbpaste or the relay /clipboard endpoint. NEVER write the key value to any file or log.

project.description: GCP project ID to scope the key list

_meta.keyHandling: The API key lands on the OS clipboard IF the click is a trusted user gesture. NEVER store the key in a file, log, buffer, or this recipe output.

clipboardLimitation.status: VERIFIED: button resolves and is clicked correctly (step s3 ok, resolvedVia: cached). Clipboard write does NOT complete from programmatic click.
clipboardLimitation.cause: Chrome's clipboard security model requires a trusted user gesture (real input event) for navigator.clipboard.writeText(). Programmatic el.click() via chrome.scripting.executeScript is not trusted.
workarounds: Add 'clipboardWrite' to extension manifest permissions and rebuild — extension clipboard writes are trusted
Use a future mouse_click action type (calls trustedMouseClick via CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent which IS trusted)
User manually clicks 'Copy API key' after recipe navigates to the correct page

_meta.selectorNotes: The copy button has stable aria-label 'Copy API key' and class xap-copy-to-clipboard. Multiple copy buttons exist if multiple keys are listed — this recipe clicks the first one (top of table = most recently created key). To copy a specific key, a key_suffix param and JS-based row filtering would be needed (not yet implemented).

copy-api-key-btn.description: Per-row copy button. aria-label 'Copy API key' is stable. Class xap-copy-to-clipboard is also stable. The first match in DOM order is the first key row.

chain.note: Click 'Copy API key' on the first key row. aria-label='Copy API key' is stable. The key value is now on the OS clipboard.
Read page state to confirm copy button was clicked (look for toast/snackbar confirmation). Key value is on clipboard — do NOT store it here.
